Benfica season|2015–16]] | nextseason = [[2017–18 S.L. Benfica season|2017–18]] }} The 2016–17 season was [[S.L. Benfica|Sport Lisboa e Benfica]]'s [[List of S.L. Benfica seasons|113th season]] in existence and the club's [[Primeira Liga#All-time Primeira Liga table|83rd consecutive season]] in the top flight of [[Football in Portugal|Portuguese football]]. It started on 7 August 2016 with the [[2016 Supertaça Cândido de Oliveira|Supertaça Cândido de Oliveira]] match and concluded on 28 May 2017 with the [[2017 Taça de Portugal Final|Taça de Portugal final]]. Benfica played in the [[2016–17 Primeira Liga|Primeira Liga]] as three-time defending champions, and were successful in defending their title, becoming a four-time champions (''tetra'') for the first time in their history; setting a new record of 36 league titles. In the [[2016–17 Taça da Liga|Taça da Liga]], Benfica, who also participated as the three-time defending holders, lost to eventual winners [[Moreirense F.C.|Moreirense]] in the semi-finals. It was Benfica's first defeat in the competition since 31 October 2007, which ended a 42-game unbeaten run. In the [[2016–17 Taça de Portugal|Taça de Portugal]], Benfica beat [[Vitória S.C.|Vitória de Guimarães]] to win their 26th trophy – a new record. With this victory, Benfica also achieved their [[Double (association football)#Portugal|11th double]] (''dobradinha'') and second treble of league, cup and super cup, 36 years after [[1980–81 S.L. Benfica season|the first one]]. Internationally, Benfica played in the [[2016–17 UEFA Champions League|UEFA Champions League]], where they reached the knockout phase for the first time in two consecutive years. They were eliminated from the competition in round of 16 by [[Borussia Dortmund]] on 4–1 aggregate.
